summary: Lane County, OR Siuslaw lookout: 1934 pole tower, 1960 41-ft tower; cab moved to Iron Mountain in 1976 and removed in 2007; no source describes the site now.

corrections.proposed: 15-ft pole tower with L-4 cab (1934); 41-ft treated timber tower with R-6 flat cab (1960)
corrections.why: The L-4 cab belongs to the 1934 pole tower. The 12.5 m (41 ft) height in the record belongs to the 1960 R-6 tower, so the record mixed the two towers.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com give 1974 for removal of the first tower. The Forest Lookouts page says the cab was dismantled in April 1976, and both Iron Mountain pages and the 2007 report date the move to 1976. The story gives both dates and says which source gives which.

notes_for_editor: The brief's design L-4 with height 12.5 m mixes the two towers (see corrections). Iron Mountain is in Linn County on the Willamette NF, not Lane County. No source read describes the Herman Peak site today. Used 1 WebSearch and about 6 page reads.
